results.caption: POV: Your wife deserves her dream home 🥹 When we bought this abandoned house, this space was completely gutted. I built the cabinets, laid the floors, tiled the backsplash, added the lighting, built the bar, and basically touched every inch of this kitchen/dining/bar area. But the finishing pieces are what make it feel like home. So I’m using @The Home Depot Décor Days as the perfect excuse to bring everything together with a new runner, bar chairs, cookware, stoneware, glasses, silverware, dish towels, and a few countertop pieces that make the whole space feel more finished and ready for hosting. The Home Depot’s Fall Décor Days savings event is almost here, happening September 17–23, where you’ll be able to save up to 50% OFF select furniture & decor when you shop online at homedepot.com. It’s only one week, so if you’ve been wanting to refresh your space for fall, this is definitely the time to start getting your add-to-cart list ready! And since you can shop online with free shipping, fast delivery, and hassle-free returns, it makes a seasonal refresh feel way easier than taking on another giant renovation 😅 #HomeDepotDecor #FallDecorDays #HomeDepotPartner @homedepot

results.transcript: The internet begged me not to buy this abandoned house, but my wife was six months pregnant, deserved her dream home, and this was the only way I could give it to her. You see, we're not made of money, so I've been slowly renovating this kitchen for over two years, but luckily, with the Home Depot's fall decor days, it's really easy to style our home on a budget, which comes in clutch, because typically I have to sacrifice style for price. But from these dates above, the Home Depot is having up to 50% off select furniture and decor, and you'd be silly not to take advantage of it, because for me, my kitchen isn't just one space. It also ties into our dining room over here, and I knew I wanted something special here, so I came up with the crazy idea to build a concrete arch bar from scratch, which is not going to be easy to tie into my kitchen. But luckily, with the Home Depot, it's never been easier to make seamless seasonal updates, with their easy online shopping, free shipping, fast delivery, and no hassle returns. Of course, not to mention everything you see me using to build this unique bar was purchased at homedepot.com too, and shipped right to my house. I won't lie, I don't always get the design decisions right, but what I do know is I built this space from scratch to host family and friends, and that has been the most rewarding part, because let me remind you how far we've come, and before I show you the finished product, I've poured years of my life into this space, but the decor is really what pulls it all together. And with the power of the Home Depot's fall decor days, this is what I transformed it into, so let me know what you think in the comments.
